scenario_meta.description: A chain of walking polar cities crosses an aurora-lit ice shelf, trading heat, route rights, food cultures, spare legs, weather predictions, and citizenship favors. Build a dense social simulation around convoy scheduling, fuel debt, inter-city marriages, border inspections, black-market engine parts, and public ceremonies where each city's reputation can rise or fall.
scenario_meta.simulation_objective: Balance fuel logistics, inter-city reputation, and diplomatic marriages to ensure city survival.

A bureaucratic intern caught in a web of forged transit permits.
creator_conflict_hooks: A collision course between two major cities is revealed to be intentional sabotage.
The discovery of a 'Static Zone' where cities cannot move creates a desperate land grab.

extra_world_events.title: New Mineral Vein Discovered
extra_world_events.description: Zale the Ice-Borer reports a significant new vein of rare earth minerals in the Permafrost Drill Station's sector, but it appears to be in disputed territory.

extra_world_events.title: Rival City Claims New Mineral Vein
extra_world_events.description: The Glimmer-Drift city-state has formally filed a counter-claim for the newly discovered mineral vein. A legal dispute is now escalated, requiring diplomatic intervention.

extra_world_events.title: Archive Breach: Migration Route Data Compromised
extra_world_events.description: A minor data breach has been detected in the Citizenship Favor Archive. Initial reports suggest specific migration route ledgers were accessed, potentially by a rival city's agent.

extra_world_events.title: Impending Border Closure Threatens Docking Rights
extra_world_events.description: Rumors spread that a major city is threatening to close its borders, impacting our city's docking rights. Diplomatic pressure or leverage is urgently needed to secure passage.

extra_world_events.title: Critical Hydraulic Line Sabotaged
extra_world_events.description: A primary hydraulic line in the Leg-Joint Maintenance Pit shows signs of intentional tampering, risking a gait malfunction and city slowdown. Investigation needed.

extra_world_events.title: Emergency Session: Mineral Claim Hearing Scheduled
extra_world_events.description: The High Court has fast-tracked a hearing for the disputed mineral vein. Diplomatic representatives are urgently needed to present our city's case.

extra_world_events.title: Rival Scout Activity Near Disputed Drill Site
extra_world_events.description: Unidentified scout vessels from a rival city have been sighted near the disputed mineral vein in the Permafrost Drill Station's sector, possibly attempting to survey or secure the area.

extra_world_events.title: Archive Breach: Suspect Identified
extra_world_events.description: Initial investigation into the archive breach points to a junior clerk, Scribe Malen, as a potential accomplice. His recent unusual activity is noted.

extra_world_events.title: Blackmail Opportunity: Rival Official's Secret
extra_world_events.description: A sensitive ledger detailing a rival city official's illicit fuel trades has been discovered. This could be leverage to secure favorable docking rights or ease border tensions.

extra_world_events.title: Gait Instability Detected: Sabotage Spreading
extra_world_events.description: Despite repairs, the city's gait is unstable. Further inspection reveals micro-fractures in adjacent leg joints, suggesting a more widespread and coordinated sabotage effort.
